sub_indicators.label: Address register
sub_indicators.subject: dpi.registry
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Universal Postal Union's Addressing the World asks every country for a national addressing policy, an address for everyone and an address register other systems can use.
criteria: A source from the past three years says there is no national addressing system.
A national addressing policy is adopted, or street naming, numbering or digital addressing is under way in some cities.
An address register or digital addressing system is in service.
The addressing system covers the whole country, rural areas included.
The post, emergency services, utilities or other registers use the address system.

gaps.4: No source found since October 2023 says other services use the address system.
gaps.3: No source found since October 2023 says the addressing system covers the whole country.
gaps.2: No source found since October 2023 says: is an address register or digital addressing system in service.
gaps.1: No source found since October 2023 says: is an addressing system under way.

ladder.empty: Nothing found names an addressing system, or says there is none.
ladder.unplaced: Nothing found since October 2023 says whether an addressing system is under way or in service.
